# ShipStack

> ShipStack (shipstack.tools) ranks AI tools by use case for vibe coders and builders, and tracks new AI tool launches weekly. Data verified 2026-10-14. Rankings are editorial; sponsorships never affect rank.

## Data
- [Tools JSON API](https://shipstack.tools/api/tools.json): all tools, ranks, verified pricing
- [Full text for LLMs](https://shipstack.tools/llms-full.txt)

## Categories
- [Best AI coding agents & IDEs](https://shipstack.tools/best-ai-coding-agents/): top pick Cursor
- [Best App builders (prompt-to-app)](https://shipstack.tools/best-ai-app-builders/): top pick Lovable
- [Best Deploy & hosting](https://shipstack.tools/best-deploy-hosting-for-ai-apps/): top pick Vercel
- [Best Backend, database & auth](https://shipstack.tools/best-backend-database-auth/): top pick Supabase
- [Best Design-to-code](https://shipstack.tools/best-design-to-code-tools/): top pick Figma Make
- [Best AI APIs & models](https://shipstack.tools/best-ai-apis-models/): top pick Anthropic API (Claude)
- [Best Agent frameworks](https://shipstack.tools/best-agent-frameworks/): top pick LangGraph
- [Best Testing & debugging](https://shipstack.tools/best-ai-testing-debugging-tools/): top pick Sentry
